chunks: The worst of earnings is the earning of usury.

key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury; forbidden excess in financial transactions
key_terms.شَرُّ الْمَكَاسِبِ: the worst forms of livelihood and earning
key_terms.كَسْبُ الرِّبَا: income acquired through usury or interest-based gain

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about earning through usury?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns usury by declaring it the worst kind of earning. It emphasizes the grave moral and legal corruption involved in wealth acquired through riba.
